This table is a collection of attributes needed for the Product Strategy Process
Unique indeces: productID, strategyID and, order
Links out to: product strategy process BOM, inventory, productopn operator workcenter, co product, approved workcenter, approved supplier and, work order process

props.label: Standard Positions
props.description: The default number of workcenter positions to use for the productStrategyProcess. (REQUIRED, DEFAULT=1)

props.label: Cycle Time
props.description: Cycle time is measured in Seconds per Inventory Unit

props.label: Distribution Percentage
props.description:
The percentage of the Work Order Qty to be allocated to the primary workcenter. Total of all alternates and primary workcenters should not exceed 100%. 

(REQUIRED, Default 1 (100% for primary workcenter))

props.label: Ideal Rate
props.description: The Ideal Rate is used for indicating 100% run time, 100% quality what you would expect the workcenter to produce. This rate is used in OEE calculations. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

props.label: Lead Time
props.description: Supplier lead time

props.label: Minimum Production Run Time
props.description: In hours the minimum amount of time a production run can be scheduled for.  (Ex: 8-hour job with 2-hour min will get up to 4 schedules with setup time per each if there is availability on a calendar)

props.label: Percent To Start
props.description: Required percent (of total quantity) until successor process can start (or in case of auto will start). For use with  startToStart =true dependency types.

props.label: Production Offal Allowed
props.description:
Offal Allowance indicates the variance allowed when the workcenter is in a production mode - for scrap / offal production. The variance can be a % of the Work Order Qty, Fixed Qty or Fixed Qty/Work Order Qty. This will be considered in the Work Order Completion algorithm.
Global: Set on Process
Product/Workcenter Specific: Set on Strategy Process
Workcenter Specific: Set on Workcenter
(REQUIRED, DEFAULT = 0)

props.label: Production Operators
props.description: The number of operators required to use the work center for production.

props.label: Quantity To Start
props.description: Required quantity (in productStrategy.consumtionUnit) until successor process can start (or in case of auto will start). For use with  startToStart =true dependency types.

props.label: Quoted Rate
props.description: The Quoted Rate represents the target value that you may have used for estimating or quoting this project to your customer. This can be used to evaluate how close you are between your target and actual production. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

props.label: Setup Offal Allowed
props.description:
Offal Allowance indicates the variance allowed when the workcenter is in a setup mode - for scrap / offal production. The variance can be a % of the Work Order Qty, Fixed Qty or Fixed Qty/Work Order Qty. This will be considered in the Work Order Completion algorithm.
Global: Set on Process
Product Specific: Set on Strategy Process
Workcenter Specific: Set on Workcenter
Process-Workcenter Specific: Set on approved workcenter

(REQUIRED, DEFAULT = 0)

props.label: Setup Operators
props.description: The number of operators required to setup the work center for this product.

props.label: Setup Rate
props.description: The amount of time setup takes.  This is always in terms of "Hours" .

props.label: Standard Rate
props.description: The standard rate represents the typically expected production rate at this workcenter. Taking into account typical downtime, material shortages, etc. This rate is used for planning purposes, but not used for OEE calculations. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.

props.label: Time To Start
props.description: Required time in seconds until successor process can start (or in case of auto will start). For use with  startToStart =true dependency types.

props.label: Unit Per Cycle
props.description: Quantity produced per cycle

props.label: Unit Weight
props.description: Weight per unit (DEFAULT = 0)

props.label: Active
props.description: System flag indicates whether the product strategy process is active (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = TRUE)

props.label: Default Distribution
props.description: if default distribution = True, this strategy process will create a work order distribution record upon work order creation. when false - no distribution will be created for this WC but can be added to the WO manually after the fact (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = TRUE)

props.label: Final
props.description: Internal Use Only - Keeps track of final process of strategy

props.label: Finished Good
props.description: Finished Good indicates the end product (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

props.label: Transfer Serial
props.description: Processes with "Transfer Serial" attribute will advance inventory from either the prior process or a BOM component with consumption type "transfer serial". Processes with "Transfer Serial" must have a predecessor or a single item in BOM whose consumption is configured as "transfer serial"

props.label: Use Workcenter Rates
props.description: If useWorkcenterRates is set to true, the standard, setup, ideal, and quoted rates set on the workcenter will be used. (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

props.label: Wip
props.description: Work in progress (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = FALSE)

props.description: description

props.description: Links out to other system

props.description: Process unique code - Label field (UNIQUE, REQUIRED)

props.label: Product Strategy Code
props.description: Label field ( name- version) - (REQUIRED)

props.label: Production Type Name
props.description: Name of the strategy process type - Label field (UNIQUE, REQUIRED)

props.label: Document Design Name
props.description: The name of the document design.

props.label: Weight Unit Name
props.description: The name of the Unit.

props.label: Product
props.description: Label field ( number - revision) - (REQUIRED)

props.label: Number
props.description: Sequence - shared between multiple production Runs, if co-production

props.label: Run Performance
props.description:
Performance = (idealRate * totalCount) / runTime

totalCount = produced+scrap

includeInProductionCounts = 1

props.label: Run Quality
props.description:
scrap / totalProduction

totalProduction (produced + scrap), Where WorkcenterMode.includeInProductionCounts = 1

props.label: Changeover Time
props.description:
Changeover Time - is the actual time spent in changeover during this production run (seconds)

Aggregate Workcenter History Records falling between productionRun.startAt and productionRun.endAt where modeType.changeover = 1.

Note: multiple setups/changeovers that occur during a single production run will impact this number.

props.label: Run Time
props.description:
Run Time (seconds) Aggregation:

The aggregation looks at workcenterHistory records, that fall between the productionRun.startAt and productionRun.endAt to determine based on the Events (not Modes) whether the time was spend up, or down.

Planned Production Time = resource shift availability (total hours) between productionRun.startAt & productionRun.EndAt (do not excluded plannedDowntime, include all 'avialable' time); Planned Prod Time is always based on the calendar Available time for the workcenter. User must adjust the calendar - when appropriate to adjust the planned production time.

Run Time = Planned Production Time (Minus)-

workcenterHistory records where PlannedDowntime Or UnPlannedDowntime ==1

props.label: Planned Downtime
props.description:
Sum of all 'unplanned downtime' during the productionRun - based on workcenter history where eventType.plannedDowntime=true

Duration in Seconds

props.label: Unplanned Downtime
props.description:
Sum of all 'unplanned downtime' during the productionRun - based on workcenter history where eventType.unplannedDowntime=true

Duration in Seconds

props.label: Avg Cycle Time (s)
props.description:
Average Cycle time (seconds/unit)

runTime / (included produced + included scrap)

props.label: Earned Labor Hours
props.description:
Earned Labor Hours:

(Produced (good only) / Standard Rate) * approvedWorkcenter.crewSize (for all outputs of the run)

props.label: Earned Machine Hours
props.description: (Produced (good only) / Standard Rate) - for all outputs of the run.

props.label: Excluded Production
props.description: Total Production where includeInProductionCounts = 0

props.label: Excluded Scrap
props.description: Total Scrap where includeInProductionCounts = 0

props.label: Produced
props.description:
Total produced where includeInProductionCounts = 1

This  is the total throughput for the entire production run in good units made.

props.label: Scrap
props.description: Total Scrap where includeInProductionCounts = 1

props.label: Tot Included Production
props.description: This is the total production for the run - including all included production + scrap entries where "include in production counts ==1" based on the mode at time of entry

props.label: Total Required
props.description: The aggregate of all required quantities across all outputs for this run.

props.label: Expected Crew
props.description: Crew Aggregate is the sum of all production output - standard operator crew sizes.

props.label: Actual Crew
props.description:
Pull from productionSetup.crewSize when Setup is Cleared.

Note: the crew size at the productionSetup may apply to multiple outputs.

props.label: Changeover Aggregate
props.description: Sum of all changeoverTimes of all production outputs for the run.

props.label: Ideal Aggregate
props.description: Sum of all Ideal rates for all production outputs - this defines the total expected throughput per hour for this Run.

props.label: Standard Aggregate
props.description: The consolidated standard rate, for all outputs in the Run.

props.label: Actual Labor Hours
props.description: Run Time * Actual Crew Size

props.label: End Date
props.description: The actual date/time of when this Run ended (ie. production setup cleared)

props.label: Start Date
props.description: The actual date/time of when this Run began (ie production setup added)

props.label: Production Setup Id
props.description: The primary unique ID of the record.  Every model should have an id field.

props.label: Created At
props.description: The date and time the record was created.

props.label: Updated At
props.description: The date and time the record was last updated.
